title: Pumpire: Unified Benchmark for Metric Distance Estimation
title_zh: Pumpire: 统一的度量距离估算基准

paragraphs.en: We present Pumpire , a unified benchmark for evaluating metric point-pair distance estimation capability of both image- and video-level 3D foundation models, with or without depth priors. In contrast to previous approaches that normally evaluate depth and camera intrinsics separately or evaluate point-clouds with geometric similarity metrics, which cannot directly reflect models’ point-to-point distance estimation capability, Pumpire directly assesses point-to-point distances from the reconstructed geometry. To this end, we collect a large-scale and diverse dataset ( pumpire-6k ) comprising 100 real-world scenes, each annotated with physically measured point-pair distances and containing 64 frames, for a total of 6,400 frames. Building on this dataset, we establish a holistic evaluation protocol that covers both image- and video-level 3D foundation models and enables direct assessment of point-pair distance errors and cross-setting comparison. We conduct extensive experiments across 29 baseline configurations of representative 3D foundation models and provide a comprehensive analysis of the results. By offering this benchmark, we target the more fundamental ability to perceive and estimate physical scale in the reconstructed 3D space, which prior evaluation protocols have largely overlooked. The project page can be found at https://pumpire.github.io/
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Pumpire，这是一个统一的基准测试，用于评估图像级和视频级 3D 基础模型在有无深度先验条件下的指标点-对距离估计能力。 与以往通常分别评估深度和相机内参，或使用几何相似性指标评估点云的方法不同——这些方法无法直接反映模型点对点的距离估计能力——Pumpire 直接从重建的几何结构中评估点对点距离。 为此，我们收集了一个大规模且多样化的数据集（pumpire-6k），包含 100 个真实世界场景，每个场景都标注了物理测量的点-对距离，并包含 64 帧图像，总计 6,400 帧。 基于该数据集，我们建立了一套全面的评估协议，涵盖图像级和视频级 3D 基础模型，能够直接评估点-对距离误差并进行跨设置比较。 我们在 29 种具有代表性的 3D 基础模型基准配置上进行了广泛实验，并对结果进行了全面分析。 通过提供这一基准测试，我们旨在关注一个更基础的能力：感知并估计重建 3D 空间中的物理尺度，而以往的评估协议大多忽略了这一点。 项目页面可访问 https://pumpire.github.io/

paragraphs.en: Accurate estimation of metric distances between 3D point pairs—such as the physical separation between objects or individual object scale—has been a foundational capability across modern intelligent systems. In autonomous driving, translation errors between 3D detections and ground truth are associated with collision rates Taamazyan et al. (2024) ; Caesar et al. (2020) . In robotic manipulation, grasp success rates depend on 3D spatial measurements, not pixel-level depth accuracy alone Hietanen et al. (2021) ; Hu et al. (2026) . In vision‑language models Cheng et al. (2024) ; Chen et al. (2024) ; Shi et al. (2026) ; Ma et al. (2025) ; Yang et al. (2025) , limitations in accurately recovering metric distances and object scales remain a critical bottleneck for spatial reasoning and physical task execution. Hence, accurate metric point‑pair distance estimation serves as a core enabler of safe, reliable, and generalizable behavior.

paragraphs.en: Recent progress in metric 3D foundation models—exemplified by recent works Wang et al. () ; Hu et al. (2024) ; Lin et al. () ; Leroy et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2026a) ; Ke et al. (2026) —has made it feasible to recover metric distances between arbitrary points in a scene from RGB inputs. These models can be categorized along two axes. The first concerns the input configuration: image-level models operate on a single image, whereas video-level models leverage multi-frame observations. The second concerns the prediction paradigm: estimation models directly recover scene geometry from RGB inputs, while completion models additionally condition on sparse depth priors to improve accuracy. Despite these advances, three critical gaps remain.
paragraphs.zh: 度量 3D 基础模型的最新进展——以近期研究 Wang et al. () ; Hu et al. (2024) ; Lin et al. () ; Leroy et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2026a) ; Ke et al. (2026) 为例——已使得从 RGB 输入中恢复场景内任意点之间的度量距离成为可能。 这些模型可以沿着两个维度进行分类。 第一个维度与输入配置有关：图像级模型基于单张图像运行，而视频级模型则利用多帧观察信息。 第二个维度与预测范式有关：估计模型直接从 RGB 输入中恢复场景几何结构，而补全模型则会额外结合稀疏深度先验以提高准确性。 尽管取得了这些进展，但仍有三个关键问题尚未解决。

paragraphs.en: First, existing benchmarks for depth and camera intrinsics estimation are insufficient to characterize a model’s point-pair distance estimation capability. Finding 6 shows that strong performance on depth and camera intrinsics benchmarks—even when considered jointly—does not necessarily translate into accurate metric distance estimation, highlighting the need for direct evaluation of point-pair distances.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，现有的深度和相机内参估计基准测试不足以全面反映模型对点间距离的估计能力。 发现 6 表明，即便将深度和相机内参的基准测试结果联合考虑，其优异表现也不一定能转化为准确的度量距离估计，这凸显了对点间距离进行直接评估的必要性。

paragraphs.en: Second, existing point-cloud benchmarks are also not designed to directly evaluate metric point-pair distance estimation. Current benchmarks primarily assess geometric fidelity using metrics such as Chamfer Distance, Accuracy, Completion, and F1-Score Wang et al. (2025a) ; Leroy et al. (2024) ; Cabon et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2025b) , or point-wise reconstruction errors Wang et al. () , rather than directly evaluating the accuracy of metric distance estimation between arbitrary point pairs. Meanwhile, recent spatial reasoning benchmarks Cheng et al. (2024) ; Chen et al. (2024) ; Liao et al. (2024) ; Guo et al. (2026) ; Xu et al. (2026) explicitly evaluate metric distance reasoning, but at a coarse, object-level granularity through question answering. Consequently, neither benchmark type directly assesses metric distance estimation at the point level, leaving the ability to recover physical distances between arbitrary point pairs insufficiently evaluated.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，现有的点云基准测试也未设计用于直接评估度量点距距离估计。 当前的基准测试主要通过诸如 Chamfer 距离、准确率、完整度和 F1 分数等指标来评估几何保真度 Wang et al. (2025a) ; Leroy et al. (2024) ; Cabon et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. paragraphs.en: In this work, we make the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们做出了以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: We introduce the first unified benchmark for directly evaluating the metric point-pair distance estimation capability of 3D foundation models, enabling unified comparisons across image- and video-level estimation and completion settings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了首个统一基准，用于直接评估 3D 基础模型对度量点距距离的估计能力，从而能够在图像级和视频级的估计与补全场景中进行统一比较。

paragraphs.en: We curate a real-world benchmark dataset comprising 100 diverse scenes and 6,400 frames, annotated with physically measured point-pair distances and spanning indoor and outdoor environments with varying levels of difficulty, enabling comprehensive evaluation of metric 3D foundation models under diverse real-world conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们整理了一个真实世界基准数据集，包含100个多样化的场景和6400帧图像，并标注了通过物理测量获得的点-点距离。该数据集涵盖了不同难度水平的室内和室外环境，能够支持在多样化真实世界条件下对度量3D基础模型进行全面评估。

paragraphs.en: We conduct comprehensive evaluations across 29 baseline configurations of representative 3D foundation models and present empirical insights into metric point-pair distance estimation, revealing the strengths and limitations of different model categories and guiding downstream applications.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对代表性的三维基础模型进行了 29 种基准配置的全面评估，并针对指标点距距离估计提供了经验性见解，揭示了不同模型类别的优势与局限性，并为下游应用提供了指导。

paragraphs.en: Recent 3D foundation models have advanced both cross-domain generalization and metric-scale recovery from visual observations. At the image level, MiDaS Ranftl et al. (2020) and Depth Anything v2 Yang et al. (2024) improve generalization through diverse training data, while Metric3D family Yin et al. (2023) ; Hu et al. (2024) and Unidepth Piccinelli et al. (2024) ; Piccinelli et al. (2025) explicitly account for camera geometry to recover metric depth. MoGe-2 Wang et al. () instead represents metric geometry through point maps. Beyond single-image prediction, video-level methods exploit geometric constraints across observations. DUSt3R Wang et al. (2024) reconstructs geometry from image pairs, and MASt3R Leroy et al. paragraphs.en: Geometry completion additionally incorporates depth measurements as metric constraints, requiring methods to handle incomplete observations and sensor noise. At the image level, CDM Liu et al. (2025) addresses camera-specific noise, while Lingbot-Depth Tan et al. (2026) refines incomplete and noisy depth through masked depth modeling. (2026) incorporates depth observations through parameter-efficient test-time adaptation. paragraphs.en: Limitations of current benchmarks. In existing real-world datasets, point-pair distances derived from sensor-based depth maps can be inaccurate on reflective or transparent surfaces (Figure 2 a ), thin structures and object boundaries (Figure 2 b ), and even ordinary surfaces affected by inherent sensor noise (Figure 2 c ). Synthetic datasets provide noise-free geometry but may not reflect real-world performance due to the domain gap (Figure 2 d ). We therefore collect real-world scenes and manually measure physical point-pair distances with a tape measure.
paragraphs.zh: 当前基准测试的局限性。 在现有的真实世界数据集中，基于传感器深度图推导出的点间距离在反射或透明表面（图 2a）、薄结构和物体边界（图 2b），甚至受传感器固有噪声影响的普通表面上（图 2c）都可能不准确。 合成数据集虽然提供了无噪声的几何信息，但由于领域差异，可能无法反映真实世界中的表现（图 2d）。 因此，我们收集了真实世界的场景，并使用卷尺手动测量物理点间距离。

paragraphs.en: Large-scale collection. We collect pumpire-6k from 100 diverse real-world scenes, including 40 indoor and 60 outdoor scenes. For each scene, we capture a sequence of 200–300 frames and uniformly sample 64 frames to reduce inter-frame redundancy, yielding 6,400 frames in total. Each sequence provides 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 RGB images, RGB-aligned depth maps, camera intrinsics, the physically measured distance between two sticker centers, and their pixel coordinates in each frame. We annotate the sticker coordinates using a coarse-to-fine pipeline that combines manual anchor-frame annotation, CoTracker3-based propagation Karaev et al. (2025) , and frame-by-frame verification. Further details are provided in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 大规模采集。 我们从 100 个多样化的真实世界场景（包括 40 个室内场景和 60 个室外场景）中采集了 pumpire-6k。 对于每个场景，我们拍摄了 200–300 帧的序列，并均匀采样 64 帧以减少帧间冗余，最终共得到 6,400 帧。 每个序列提供了 1280 × 720 的 RGB 图像、与 RGB 对齐的深度图、相机内参、两个贴纸中心之间的物理测量距离，以及它们在每帧中的像素坐标。 我们采用一种从粗略到精细的流程对贴纸坐标进行标注，该流程结合了手动锚定帧标注、基于 CoTracker3 的传播方法 Karaev et al. paragraphs.en: Diverse surface coverage. As discussed above, sensor-derived depth annotations can be unreliable under challenging optical properties, texture patterns, and geometric structures. By physically measuring point-pair distances, we prevent these sensing errors from propagating into the ground truth, allowing pumpire-6k to cover a broad range of such conditions for comprehensive model evaluation. paragraphs.en: Randomized viewpoint acquisition. During capture, we randomize the camera trajectories to ensure that the sequences encompass a wide variety of motion modes, exemplified by randomized distance scaling mode (bidirectional near–far transitions), variations in camera orientation, stochastic in-image positioning of stickers, and perspective variations across a wide range of viewing angles and distances. paragraphs.en: Back-projection protocol. As later demonstrated in Finding 6 , point-pair distance estimation depends on the coupling between depth and camera intrinsics. We therefore back-project predicted depth using the intrinsics associated with its camera space: predicted intrinsics (or canonical intrinsics for Metric3D Yin et al. (2023) and Metric3D v2 Hu et al. (2024) ) for estimation models, and ground-truth intrinsics for completion models conditioned on sensor depth. For video-level evaluation, we sample 32 groups of 10 frames per scene and average the metrics across all predictions. Video-level completion models additionally receive sensor-depth priors, with both depth and intrinsics provided to MapAnything Keetha et al. (2026) and pi3x Wang et al. (2026a) .
paragraphs.zh: 反向投影协议。正如后续在发现 6 中所示，点距距离估计依赖于深度与相机内参之间的耦合。因此，我们使用与其相机空间相关的内参对预测深度进行反向投影：对于估计模型，使用预测内参（或 Metric3D Yin et al. (2023) 和 Metric3D v2 Hu et al. (2024) 的规范内参）；对于以传感器深度为条件的补全模型，则使用真实内参。在视频级评估中，我们从每个场景采样 10 帧组成 32 组，并对所有预测结果的平均指标进行计算。视频级补全模型还会接收传感器深度先验信息，其中深度和内参均提供给 MapAnything Keetha et al. (2026) 和 pi3x Wang et al. (2026a)。

paragraphs.en: Direct evaluation of point-pair distance estimation. To investigate why direct evaluation is necessary, we conduct two experiments. First, we evaluate five image-level geometry estimation models on standard depth and camera-intrinsics benchmarks. Table 7 summarizes their average ranks (see full results in appendix E ). The rankings exhibit obvious task-specific discrepancies: Unidepth performs best on depth but relatively poorly on intrinsics, whereas MoGe-2 shows the opposite trend. Moreover, despite achieving the best combined depth–intrinsics rank, MoGe-2 is outperformed by Unidepthv2 on Pumpire (Table 3 ). Second, under the Pumpire evaluation protocol, we replace each model’s predicted intrinsics with ground-truth intrinsics when back-projecting its predicted depth, which degrades performance in most cases. These results demonstrate that point-pair distance estimation depends on depth–intrinsics coupling and cannot be reliably characterized by separate benchmarks, motivating its direct evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 对点-对距离估计的直接评估。 为了探究为何需要进行直接评估，我们开展了两项实验。 首先，我们在标准的深度和相机内参基准数据集上评估了五种图像级几何估计模型。 表7总结了这些模型的平均排名（完整结果见附录E）。 这些排名表现出明显的任务特异性差异：Unidepth在深度估计上表现最佳，但在内参估计上相对较差，而MoGe-2则呈现出相反的趋势。 此外，尽管MoGe-2在深度与内参的综合排名中表现最佳，但在Pumpire数据集上却不如Unidepthv2（表3）。 其次，在Pumpire评估协议下，当对预测的深度进行反向投影时，我们将每个模型预测的内参替换为真实内参，这导致大多数情况下性能下降。 这些结果表明，点-对距离估计依赖于深度与内参的耦合关系，无法通过独立的基准测试可靠地描述，因此有必要对其进行直接评估。

paragraphs.en: Sensor depth versus learned 3D foundation models. We provide the first quantified comparison between raw sensor depth and learned 3D foundation models for point-pair distance estimation. On normal scenes (Figure 4 a ), raw RealSense D435 depth is a remarkably strong baseline: only 5 of the 18 baseline configurations approach or surpass its δ 1.05 \delta_{1.05} , all of them completion models (Lingbot-Depth, PriorDA, Omni-dc, LDCM, and InfiniDepth), while the best estimation model reaches barely half its accuracy. The ordering reverses on challenging scenes, where 16 of the 18 baseline configurations achieve a lower RE than the sensor: optical sensitivity and structural vulnerability invalidate active measurement, whereas learned models fall back on geometric priors.
paragraphs.zh: 传感器深度与学习得到的三维基础模型对比。 我们首次对原始传感器深度与学习得到的三维基础模型在点-点距离估计方面进行了量化比较。 在正常场景（图4a）中，原始RealSense D435深度数据是一个表现出色的基准：18种基准配置中仅有5种接近或超过了其δ₁.₀₅值，且这些配置均为完成模型（Lingbot-Depth、PriorDA、Omni-dc、LDCM和InfiniDepth），而最佳估计模型的准确率甚至仅达到该基准值的一半左右。 在复杂场景中，这一排序则完全相反：18种基准配置中有16种的RE值低于传感器本身——光学敏感性和结构脆弱性使主动测量失效，而学习模型则转而依赖几何先验知识。

paragraphs.en: Distinct robustness patterns of estimation and completion. Figure 4 b contrasts the two families across scene difficulty. The challenging-to-normal RE ratio (left) yields a non-overlapping separation: estimation models stay within 1 1 – 20 × 20\times , whereas completion models degrade by 20 20 – 210 × 210\times ; the multi-view scatter (right) shows the same contrast, with estimation models lying near the y = x y=x line and completion models far below it. paragraphs.en: We introduced Pumpire, a unified benchmark for directly evaluating the metric point-pair distance estimation capability of 3D foundation models. To support this evaluation, we constructed pumpire-6k with 100 real-world scenes and 6,400 frames annotated with physically measured distances, spanning diverse indoor and outdoor environments, surface properties, and viewing conditions. Our protocol enables unified comparison across image- and video-level geometry estimation and completion models. We systematically evaluate 29 baseline configurations and conduct in-depth analyses, revealing the necessity of direct distance evaluation, distinct accuracy–robustness trade-offs across model families and sensing conditions, and the effects of multi-view context and depth priors on distance accuracy and cross-view consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 我们推出了 Pumpire，这是一个统一基准，用于直接评估 3D 基础模型对指标点-点距离的估计能力。 为支持这一评估，我们构建了 pumpire-6k，其中包含 100 个真实世界场景和 6,400 帧带有物理测量距离标注的图像，涵盖了多样的室内与室外环境、表面特性及观察条件。 我们的方案实现了图像级和视频级几何估计与补全模型之间的统一比较。 我们系统性地评估了 29 种基线配置并进行了深度分析，揭示了直接距离评估的必要性、不同模型家族和感知条件下准确性与鲁棒性之间的显著权衡，以及多视角上下文和深度先验对距离准确性和跨视角一致性的影响。

paragraphs.en: We propose a lightweight coarse-to-fine annotation pipeline (Figure 6 ) for per-frame pixel-coordinate annotation of sticker centers, substantially reducing manual annotation effort through a semi-automated human-in-the-loop framework built upon CoTracker3 Karaev et al. (2025) . In the coarse stage, the user manually clicks the centers of the two stickers on an anchor frame to initialize their pixel coordinates. These coordinates are provided to CoTracker3 as query points, which are then propagated to subsequent frames to obtain the corresponding pixel coordinates of the sticker centers throughout the sequence. The propagated trajectories are visually inspected, and whenever the tracking drift exceeds an acceptable tolerance, the current frame is selected as a new anchor, the sticker centers are re-clicked, and trajectory propagation resumes until the end of the sequence. In the fine stage, every frame is revisited, and all propagated keypoints are manually refined to pixel-level accuracy. Owing to the strong temporal coherence between adjacent frames, even subtle localization errors are readily identifiable during sequential inspection, enabling efficient local corrections and ultimately producing accurate and temporally consistent ground-truth annotations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种轻量级的粗到精标注流程（图6），用于对每帧中贴纸中心的像素坐标进行标注。该流程基于 CoTracker3 Karaev et al. (2025) 构建了一个半自动化的“人在回路”框架，从而大幅减少了手动标注的工作量。 在粗阶段，用户需要在参考帧上手动点击两个贴纸的中心点，以初始化它们的像素坐标。 这些坐标会被作为查询点提供给 CoTracker3，随后传播到后续帧中，从而获得整个序列中贴纸中心对应的像素坐标。 传播后的轨迹会经过视觉检查；一旦跟踪漂移超过了可接受的容差范围，当前帧就会被选为新的参考帧，贴纸中心会被重新点击，然后继续传播轨迹直至序列结束。 在精阶段，每一帧都会被重新处理，所有传播得到的关键点都会被手动调整至像素级精度。 由于相邻帧之间存在较强的时序一致性，即使在逐帧检查过程中出现细微的定位误差也能被轻易识别出来，这使得高效的局部修正成为可能，并最终生成准确且具有时序一致性的真实标注数据。

paragraphs.en: As summarized in Table 8 , we benchmark 26 representative method entries across four settings: 8 image-level estimation methods, 9 image-level completion methods, 6 video-level estimation methods, and 3 video-level completion methods. paragraphs.en: More importantly, even jointly considering the two benchmarks fails to predict point-pair distance estimation performance. Despite achieving the best overall depth–intrinsics ranking, MoGe-2 is consistently outperformed by Unidepthv2 on our distance estimation benchmark (Table 3 ). To further investigate this discrepancy, we replace the predicted intrinsics with ground-truth intrinsics when back-projecting the predicted depth maps. To reveal general patterns, we conduct experiments on the normal subset only. Surprisingly, this substitution degrades across the majority of metrics — 47 of the 56 model–metric pairs (Table 9 ), demonstrating that predicted depth maps are intrinsically coupled with their corresponding predicted intrinsics. These results show that neither existing depth and intrinsics benchmarks, nor their simple combination, can faithfully characterize a model’s point-pair distance estimation capability, highlighting the necessity of direct evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 更重要的是，即使将这两个基准测试联合考虑，仍然无法预测点-对距离估计的性能。 尽管 MoGe-2 在深度-内参综合排名中表现最佳，但在我们的距离估计基准测试中（表 3），其性能始终低于 Unidepthv2。 为了进一步研究这种差异，我们在反向投影预测深度图时，将预测的内参替换为真实内参。 为了揭示普遍规律，我们仅在法线子集上进行实验。 令人惊讶的是，这种替换在大多数指标上都会导致性能下降——56 个模型-指标组合中有 47 个（表 9），这表明预测深度图与其对应的预测内参存在内在耦合。 这些结果表明，现有的深度和内参基准测试，以及它们的简单组合，都无法准确反映模型对点-对距离的估计能力，这凸显了直接评估的必要性。
